# Bluesky (3 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /profile | `handle` | 1 | Get a Bluesky profile |
| /user/posts | `handle` / `user_id` | 1 | List a Bluesky user's posts |
| /post | `url` | 1 | Get a Bluesky post |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- *(none)* — no required parameters.

## Parameter Details

- `handle`: Bluesky handle (e.g. `espn.com`).
- `handle (/user/posts)` *(optional, string)*: Bluesky handle.
- `user_id` *(optional, string)*: Bluesky `did` (Bluesky's internal user ID format, e.g. `did:plc:x7d6j54pm22ufehkes6jo4jf`).
- `url`: Bluesky post URL.

## Example

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bluesky/profile?handle=espn.com" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
